message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Monday, or is observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | Sun Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2 | 3‑day weekend (Sun‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Monday Nov 13 | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | — | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |

### Quick Summary
- **January** – New Year’s Day (Sun‑Mon)
- **April** – Good Friday (Fri‑Sun)
- **May** – Victoria Day (Sat‑Mon)
- **July** – Canada Day (Sat‑Mon)
- **September** – Labour Day (Sat‑Mon)
- **October** – Thanksgiving (Sat‑Mon)
- **November** – Remembrance Day (Sat‑Mon)
- **December** – Christmas Day (Sat‑Mon)

> **Pro‑provincial notes**  
> Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc., on the 3rd Monday in February; St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17; etc.). If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know and I can add those too.
